findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used.
findings.comment:
The following equipment is observed to be in need of repair: 

1. There is ice build-up coming from the fans in the bakery walk-in freezer that is being caught on a green tray. Ensure that the issue is repaired and that the ice is removed. 
2. There is a slow leak coming from the ceiling of the bakery walk-in cooler. Ensure that this leak is repaired. 

Ensure that equipment is maintained in good repair.
findings.citation_text: 4-501.11(A) Good Repair and Proper Adjustment. (A) EQUIPMENT shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment:
The following physical facilities are observed to be in need of repair: 

1. There is missing coving to the right of the bakery walk-in freezer. Ensure that this coving is replaced and made to be smooth and easily cleanable. 
2. The sealing on the bakery handwashing sink is observed to be in disrepair. Ensure that this is re-sealed and made to be smooth and easily cleanable. 
3. There is observed to be a gap in the NUDO board behind the ice machine in the bakery. Ensure that this is re-sealed. 

Ensure that physical facilities are maintained in good repair. Ensure that all repairs are made to be smooth and easily cleanable.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: The bakery walk-in cooler fan covers were observed to have an accumulation of dust on them. This was discussed with the PIC. Ensure that these fan covers are being cleaned as often as necessary to maintain them clean.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.12 Cleaning, Frequency and Restrictions. (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment: 6-501.12: (A) Observed a large amount of debris accumulated under the supply racks next to the walk-in-freezer in bakery. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.
